query:
SELECT p.match_id, u.name as user_name,
                   p.predicted_home, p.predicted_away
            FROM predictions p
            JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
            JOIN matches m ON m.id = p.match_id
            WHERE m.kickoff_time IS NOT NULL
              AND m.kickoff_time < $1
              AND u.id != $2
            ORDER BY u.name
